The '''Dwarvish Helm''' is an [[Artifacts|Artifact]] that can be found by [[Hoes|tilling]] soil in [[The Mines]] (floor 1-39), or found inside [[Geode]]s, [[Omni Geode]]s, or [[Artifact Trove]]s.

==Donation==
Donation of this item contributes to the total count of donations for the [[Museum]].

==Bundles==
The Dwarvish Helm is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
The Dwarvish Helm is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
The Dwarvish Helm can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Wearable Dwarf Helm|class=inline}}. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
The Dwarvish Helm is not used in any [[quests]].
